query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "pending_count!: i64", MIN(activity.activity_sequence) AS first_pending_sequence, MAX(activity.activity_sequence) AS through_sequence FROM board_activity activity WHERE ((activity.root_id=? AND activity.kind='threadMessageCreated') OR (activity.message_id=? AND activity.kind='mainMessageCreated')) AND activity.message_id IS NOT NULL AND activity.actor_key<>? AND activity.activity_sequence>?
